scope_changes.reason: User approved restoring the previous WebView UI and accepting its higher memory usage while preserving all production behavior and local data.
User requested automatic update and exhaustive release verification, expanding installer/update risk.

User required self-contained dependency handling, install-root per-user data, continuous one-percent scaling without blank frames, global fox navigation, full local data removal, and clean F-drive reinstall.

User reported proportional scaling still reflowed the settings helper text; root cause was intrinsic scale-label width plus active size transitions, so the fix was limited to the approved WebView shell and its installed regression evidence.

Real pointer dragging still jumped because native window resizing moved the slider under the cursor; preview now freezes geometry until commit, and native corner clipping uses CSS-radius geometry without DPI double-scaling.

User requested pinned pins to become dimensional red glass and favorite stars dimensional yellow glass; both states now use gradient, inset highlight, depth shadow, and state-specific color while preserving the existing actions.
